CustomField.description: BRME-7020: Marks this file group as private. Private file groups are readable/writable only by members of the 'Highlights: Private Highlights Review' public group; non-private file groups remain available to all internal users. General-purpose flag — any object using file groups (Highlight, Initiative, Announcement, Budget, Amendment) can set it; highlights set it automatically from Highlight_Interaction__c.Private__c.
CustomField.label: Private
